Study plan

A six-week ESOL Reading Entry 2 plan

Move from everyday text recognition to full four-task practice with focused error review.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Week 1: purpose and layout

Collect short signs, notices, forms and messages. For each, identify source, reader, purpose and required action.

Weeks 2–3: practical detail

Alternate forms and alphabetical order with instructions, messages, vocabulary and sentence meaning. Keep a short list of repeated errors.

01PURPOSE02CLUE03EVIDENCE04ANSWER

Weeks 4–5: meaning across a text

Practise main ideas, supporting detail and simple inference. Explain every answer with words from the passage.

Week 6: four-task rhythm

Complete four varied 15-minute blocks. Review errors by skill, then repeat only the weakest skill before another mixed set.
